## NDVI Install and Library Statements

```{r}
if(!requireNamespace("MODISTools", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("MODISTools")
if(!requireNamespace("tidyverse", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("tidyverse")
if(!requireNamespace("sf", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("sf")
if(!requireNamespace("future.apply", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("future.apply")
if(!requireNamespace("here", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("here")

library(MODISTools)
library(mapview)
library(tidyverse)
library(future.apply)
library(here)
library(future)
library(terra)   
library(sf)      
library(stars)   
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
```

## Setting up bounding box

```{r}
# Load Pará boundary shapefile (replace with your path)
para_boundary <- st_read("data/para_boundary.shp")

# Check projection
st_crs(para_boundary)

# Reproject to UTM Zone 21S (EPSG:32721) for local accuracy
para_boundary <- st_transform(para_boundary, 32721)

plot(st_geometry(para_boundary), main = "Pará Boundary")
```

## Loading data for one image

```{r}
# File paths
landsat_red <- rast("data/Landsat_B4.tif")  # Red band
landsat_nir <- rast("data/Landsat_B5.tif")  # NIR band

# Clip to Pará boundary
landsat_red <- crop(landsat_red, para_boundary) |> mask(para_boundary)
landsat_nir <- crop(landsat_nir, para_boundary) |> mask(para_boundary)

# Sentinel-2 example
sentinel_red <- rast("data/Sentinel_B4.jp2")
sentinel_nir <- rast("data/Sentinel_B8.jp2")

sentinel_red <- crop(sentinel_red, para_boundary) |> mask(para_boundary)
sentinel_nir <- crop(sentinel_nir, para_boundary) |> mask(para_boundary)
```

## Calculate NDVI

```{r}
# NDVI formula: (NIR - Red) / (NIR + Red)

ndvi_landsat <- (landsat_nir - landsat_red) / (landsat_nir + landsat_red)
ndvi_sentinel <- (sentinel_nir - sentinel_red) / (sentinel_nir + sentinel_red)

# Plot NDVI
plot(ndvi_landsat, main = "NDVI - Landsat (Example)")
plot(ndvi_sentinel, main = "NDVI - Sentinel (Example)")
```

## NDVI Classification for Para, Brazil 10/02/2025

```{r}
# Paths to your Band 4 (Red) and Band 8 (NIR) files for Para
red_path <- here("data/band_data_para/para_B04.jp2")
nir_path <- here("data/band_data_para/para_B08.jp2")

# Load bands
red <- rast(red_path)
nir <- rast(nir_path)

# Calculate NDVI
ndvi <- (nir - red) / (nir + red)

# Optional: Crop to Para bounding box
para_ext <- ext(-55, -45, -5, 2) # Approximate extent for Pará
temp_raster <- rast(para_ext, crs = "EPSG:4326")
temp_raster_utm <- project(temp_raster, crs(ndvi))
para_bbox <- ext(temp_raster_utm)
ndvi_para <- crop(ndvi, para_bbox)

# Reclassify NDVI into categories
ndvi_classes <- classify(ndvi_para, 
                         rcl = matrix(c(
                           -Inf, 0, 1,     # water/shadow/snow
                            0, 0.2, 2,     # bare soil / urban
                            0.2, 0.5, 3,   # sparse vegetation
                            0.5, 0.9, 4    # dense vegetation
                         ), ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE))

# Count pixels per class
counts <- freq(ndvi_classes) %>% as_tibble()

# Map class IDs to labels
labels <- tibble(
  value = 1:4,
  class = c("< 0: water/shadow/snow",
            "0–0.2: bare soil / urban",
            "0.2–0.5: sparse vegetation",
            "0.5–0.9: dense vegetation")
)

# Join with labels and calculate percentages
counts <- counts %>%
  left_join(labels, by = "value") %>%
  mutate(percent = count / sum(count) * 100)

# Plot with ggplot2
ggplot(counts, aes(x = class, y = percent, fill = class)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "NDVI Class Distribution - Para, Brazil (2025)",
       x = "NDVI Class",
       y = "Percentage of Area (%)") +
  theme_minimal()

```

## NDVI Classification for Para, Brazil 01/01/2024 - 01/01/2025

```{r}
# -----------------------------
# 1. Define Pará bounding box
# -----------------------------
para_bbox <- st_bbox(c(xmin = -55, xmax = -45, ymin = -5, ymax = 2), crs = 4326)

# Create a grid of points (0.25° spacing; ~1189 points)
lon_seq <- seq(para_bbox$xmin, para_bbox$xmax, by = 0.25)
lat_seq <- seq(para_bbox$ymin, para_bbox$ymax, by = 0.25)
pts <- expand.grid(lon = lon_seq, lat = lat_seq)

# -----------------------------
# 2. Setup parallel plan
# -----------------------------

plan(multisession, workers = parallel::detectCores() - 1)  # leave one core free

# -----------------------------
# 3. Download NDVI in parallel
# -----------------------------
download_point <- function(i) {
  cat("Downloading point", i, "of", nrow(pts), "\n")
  temp <- try(
    MODISTools::mt_subset(
      product = "MOD13Q1",
      lat = pts$lat[i],
      lon = pts$lon[i],
      band = "250m_16_days_NDVI",
      start = "2024-01-01",
      end = "2025-01-01",
      km_lr = 0,
      km_ab = 0,
      site_name = paste0("Point_", i),
      internal = TRUE
    ), silent = TRUE
  )
  
  if(!inherits(temp, "try-error")) return(temp)
  else return(NULL)
}

ndvi_list <- future_lapply(1:nrow(pts), download_point)
ndvi_data <- bind_rows(ndvi_list)

# -----------------------------
# 4. Scale NDVI
# -----------------------------
ndvi_data <- ndvi_data %>%
  mutate(value = value / 10000)

# -----------------------------
# 5. Classify NDVI
# -----------------------------
ndvi_data <- ndvi_data %>%
  mutate(class = case_when(
    value < 0 ~ "water/shadow/snow",
    value >= 0 & value < 0.2 ~ "bare soil / urban",
    value >= 0.2 & value < 0.5 ~ "sparse vegetation",
    value >= 0.5 ~ "dense vegetation"
  ))

# -----------------------------
# 6. Summarize by date
# -----------------------------
ndvi_summary <- ndvi_data %>%
  group_by(calendar_date, class) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(calendar_date) %>%
  mutate(percent = count / sum(count) * 100)

# -----------------------------
# 7. Plot time series
# -----------------------------
ggplot(ndvi_summary, aes(x = as.Date(calendar_date), y = percent, color = class)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  labs(title = "NDVI Class Distribution Over Time - Pará, Brazil (2024)",
       x = "Date",
       y = "Percentage (%)",
       color = "NDVI Class") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

## NDVI Classification for Para, Brazil 01/01/2000 - 01/01/2025

```{r}
# -----------------------------
# 1. Create a grid of points (0.25° spacing; ~1189 points)
# -----------------------------
lon_seq <- seq(para_bbox$xmin, para_bbox$xmax, by = 0.25)

      product = "MOD13Q1",
      lat = pts$lat[i],

      start = "2000-01-01",   # <--- changed
      end = "2025-01-01",     # <--- changed
      km_lr = 0,
      km_ab = 0,
      site_name = paste0("Point_", i),
      internal = TRUE
    ), silent = TRUE
  )
  
  if(!inherits(temp, "try-error")) return(temp)

}

ndvi_list <- future_lapply(1:nrow(pts), download_point)

    value >= 0.2 & value < 0.5 ~ "sparse vegetation",
```
